notes.title: v1.5.1
notes.notes:
Melody Mania v1.5.1 has been released! 🎉
This is a minor update with improvements and fixes.

Highlights include

[list]
[*] Automatically refresh songs when txt files change, are added, or are removed. For example, you can copy or download a new song to your song folder and the song select list will update immediately
[*] Support ReplayGain loudness normalization. You can enable this in the sound options. Under the hood, this sets an option for libVLC. So if you want to use it, make sure to also set the option "Use VLC to play audio and video files" to "Always".
[*] Dropdown to select microphones in recording options.
[*] Aligned code with open source sister project.
[/list]

Fixes

[list]
[*] Fix playlist dropdown was outside bottom of screen when there are many playlists.
[*] Fix audio out of sync with lyrics sometimes when libVLC is used for playback.
[*] Upgrade to Unity 6.1. This fixes some issues, notably file and folder dialogs can use modern Windows UI again.
[/list]


For details, see the changelog on Discord.

Happy Singing! 🎤

notes.title: v1.5.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989316/040632da58872a7ca3404b4e0a99c4b075f77b9e.png[/img]Melody Mania v1.5.0 has been released! 🎉
This is a major update with improvements and fixes.

Highlights include

[list]
[*] ASIO compatible (experimental). Use professional grade audio hardware on Windows with low latency. ASIO is a registered trademark of Steinberg Media Technologies GmbH.
[*] Reorder song queue via drag and drop.
[*] Configure head start time for 'skip to next lyrics'.
[/list]

Song Select

[list]
[*] Faster scrolling through song list when holding down button for long time.
[*] Press single letter on keyboard to jump to the corresponding artist / title (depending on selected song order). Pressing more letters will jump to the corresponding song that contains the text, like in previous versions.
[*] Press "Shift+Right Arrow" resp.  "Shift+Left Arrow" to jump to the next resp. previous artist / title (depending on selected song order). Does also work with gamepad shoulder buttons.
[*] Moved icons out of cover image for better visibility (e.g. duet icon, favorite icon).
[*] Folder navigation: show preview image on top of folder icon.
[*] Folder navigation: Restore last selection when one level up.
[/list]

Mods

[list]
[*] New mod to save mic recording of last song to file.
[*] Jukebox & sing: prefer songs from the queue, otherwise choose next song randomly.
[/list]

Fixes

[list]
[*] Fix mp3 inaccuracy when using mp3 file for instrumental or vocals audio.
[*] Fix duet lyrics container was inverted (top vs. bottom) when StaticLyricsDisplayMode was set to Top.
[*] Major refactorings to fix various issues and improve stability.
[/list]

[b]Companion App v1.3.1 has been released for Android.[/b]
It includes the following improvements.

[list]
[*] Assign random color on first connect.
[*] Reorder song queue via drag and drop.
[*] Show message when no microphone could be found (e.g. because of missing Android permissions).
[*] Compatible with Google Play Games ( https://play.google.com/googleplaygames ). This allows to use the Companion App also on Desktop devices, e.g., to search and enqueue songs on a separate monitor.
[/list]

For details, see the changelog on Discord.

Happy Singing! 🎤

notes.title: v1.4.0 - Online Multiplayer and Open Source
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce the release of Melody Mania Version 1.4.0, packed with a exciting new features and enhancements that will take your karaoke experience to the next level!

[h2]What’s new[/h2]

🕹️ Online Multiplayer (experimental): Connect with friends on Steam, browse songs together, and see each other's performance when singing! Our new online multiplayer mode makes virtual karaoke parties a reality.

Note however the following restrictions:
[list]
[*] You can play online only those songs that all players have locally. For legal reasons, no copyright protected song material is sent over the internet.
[*] It is recommended to mute your voice chat when singing. This is because your singing is delayed for other players compared to the local song audio, which is played for everyone in real-time.
[/list]
🎶 Support for New Versions of the UltraStar format: We’ve upgraded our song format support to include the latest UltraStar versions, ensuring stability and compatibility with a broader range of songs and features.

🌍 Localization of the UI: Melody Mania has been localized into more languages, making the game accessible to a wider audience around the globe.

[h2]Open Source[/h2]
🔓 But that's not all! In a move to foster innovation and collaboration, large parts of Melody Mania have been made open source. You can find it on GitHub in its sister project [url=https://github.com/UltraStar-Deluxe/Play/]UltraStar Play[/url]. We invite developers and enthusiasts to contribute and help us create the ultimate karaoke experience. You can now track issues, submit bug reports, and propose new features all in one place.

Jump into Melody Mania and discover all these fantastic features today! Let’s make every moment a melody. 🎤✨

notes.title: v1.1.0
notes.notes:
[u][b]File Support[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] more supported audio and video files
[*] audio files: aac, aiff, flac, m4a, mp3, ogg, wav, wma
[*] video files: avi, f4v, flv, mkv, mov, mp4, mpg, webm, wmv
[*] as alternative, convert unsupported audio and video files
[*] dedicated #WEBSITE field in song files to use embedded browser when no local audio file present
[/list]

[u][b]Mic Input[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] multi-channel and low-latency audio input with host API selection
[*] more accurate mic calibration
[*] option to play recorded audio
[/list]

[u][b]UI[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] option to always show detailed time bar
[*] option to have player info next to notes
[*] wipe effect for lyrics color
[*] theme option to change time until next lyrics indicator image
[/list]

[u][b]Other[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] button to reset active filters in song select
[*] option to disable song folders
[/list]

[u][b]Fixes and Improvements[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] improve performance on old graphics cards by activating camera objects only when needed (e.g. particles, WebView)
[*] fix consider #START and #END fields of song files in time bar
[*] fix load player profile images with space in the path
[*] fix handle empty list of recording devices and show corresponding message
[/list]
